title: Data and R code used in: Temporal decoupling of biodiversity effects on grassland productivity and stability
description:
One key unresolved question in ecology is what drives temporal trends in biodiversity-stability relationships and how these trends link to ecosystem functioning. This knowledge gap reflects limited understanding of interspecific interactions in biodiversity–stability relationships. Using plant productivity data from a 20-year grassland biodiversity experiment, complemented by a paired 5-year experiment that controlled for legacy effects, we disentangled the contributions of species-specific dynamics and interactions-dependent processes to plant community stability.
This dataset contains data and R code for the analysis.
